hook: He was trapped inside a grounded sailboat.
narration: A man was trapped inside a sailboat that had run aground near Coronado, California.
This first view is the helicopter's infrared camera, which shows heat, so a person stands out against cold water.
A Coast Guard aircrew from Air Station Ventura put their rescue swimmer down at the wreck.
To reach the man, the swimmer tore open part of the cabin roof.
outcome: The Ventura aircrew got the trapped man out of the grounded sailboat.
title: He was trapped inside a grounded sailboat
description:
A man was trapped aboard a sailboat that ran aground near Coronado, California, on Oct. 11, 2026. A Coast Guard Air Station Ventura aircrew rescued him after the rescue swimmer tore open part of the cabin roof to reach him.
